Comment: AWS EventBridge rule: hit the public pipeline webhook every 4 hours. Replace DOMAIN and SECRET.
Name: applyforme-run
_setup_notes: 1. Create an API Destination pointing to https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/pipeline/webhook (POST)
2. Connection auth type: API Key or include Bearer in header parameters as above
3. Keep EC2 security group: inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 (or CloudFront); 8787 closed
4. Prefer the on-box SCHEDULE_RUN cron (no AWS fees) unless you need multi-region triggers
